blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bank and tax records to be presented next week before the Senate impeachment court could help determine whether former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV’s recent claims against Vice President Sara Duterte are supported by the records, the prosecution panel said Saturday. During a press conference Friday, Trillanes said Duterte had peso and US dollar time deposits in 2007 and 2008 that were not declared in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN). He also said the Chinese government and Chinese companies remitted a total of P319 million to Cale88 Food Corp., which is linked to Duterte’s husband, […]...
